d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Bybit is seeking an Asset/Wallet Operations to join our local finance/operations team. The Specialist will oversee the operation and administration of digital wallets, safeguarding crypto assets while balancing operational efficiency.
q: 3+ years of relevant experience in digital asset operations, custody, or crypto wallet management.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Computer Science, Information Technology , or related field .
Deep understanding of blockchain, smart contracts, and DeFi/Web3 projects.
Hands-on experience with wallet operations (custody, hot/warm/cold wallets, multi-signature, MPC, exchanges).
Strong knowledge of crypto security protocols and best practices.
Required to work five days per week, including Saturdays and Sundays, with three working days between Monday and Friday and two weekdays off.
Professional fluency in English is required. Mandarin Chinese is preferred but not mandatory.
r: Operate, manage, and administer hot/warm/cold wallets, ensuring security, compliance, and efficiency.
Execute and oversee cryptocurrency transactions: payments, transfers, deposits, withdrawals.
Manage wallet rebalancing across different types of wallets according to company policy.
Facilitate cross-chain transactions and interoperability between blockchain protocols.
Reconcile wallet balances and transactions regularly; investigate discrepancies.
Develop and maintain SOPs and policies for wallet operations.
Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and implement security best practices.
Liaise with auditors, regulators, and internal teams regarding wallet operations.

d: We are currently recruiting for a Legal Advisor to join our client, a global leader in medical technology, recognised for its innovation, clinical excellence and commitment to improving people's lives.

Beyond its strong global reputation, the organisation is known for its collaborative, people-focused culture and commitment to developing talent. The regional business is led by an inspiring, forward-thinking leader who values fresh perspectives, empowers people and creates an environment where individuals can genuinely make an impact.
This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established multinational organisation that combines global expertise with an entrepreneurial and dynamic regional environment.

As part of the company's Legal & Compliance function, the Legal Advisor will provide strategic, commercially focused and practical legal advice to support operations in Saudi Arabia and across the GCC.

The position will work closely with local business leadership, regional commercial teams and corporate functions to ensure that business activities are conducted in accordance with applicable laws, regulatory requirements and the company's internal policies and ethical standards.
Operating within a multinational matrix environment, the Legal Advisor will act as a trusted business partner, balancing commercial objectives with effective legal risk management and compliance.
The role will report to the Head of Legal & Compliance, Middle East & Africa.
q: Bachelor's degree in Law or equivalent recognised legal qualification.
Minimum 3 years of relevant legal experience, ideally combining private practice at a reputable law firm with an in-house legal position in a multinational organisation.
At least 2 years of in-house legal experience preferred.
Experience within the medical devices, healthcare, pharmaceutical or broader life sciences industry is highly desirable.
Solid understanding of Saudi Arabia commercial law, corporate governance and relevant GCC legal and regulatory frameworks.
Familiarity with healthcare compliance requirements, anti-bribery and anti-corruption regulations and interactions with healthcare professionals.
Demonstrated experience in commercial contract drafting, review and negotiation.
Experience operating within an international, matrix-structured organisation.
Fluency in Arabic and English, both written and spoken.
Commercial Acumen: Ability to understand business priorities and provide pragmatic, solution-oriented legal advice.
Legal & Analytical Judgment: Strong analytical capabilities, sound judgment and the ability to evaluate complex legal and compliance risks.
Negotiation & Influencing: Confident negotiator capable of managing diverse stakeholders and commercial interests.
Business Partnering: Collaborative and approachable, with the ability to build credibility and trusted relationships across all organisational levels.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal matters clearly and effectively.
Accountability & Integrity: High ethical standards, sound professional judgment and the confidence to challenge or escalate matters where necessary.
Agility & Independence: Proactive, organised and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced multinational environment.
All applications will be carefully reviewed against the requirements and selection criteria provided by our client.

Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you have not heard from us within five working days of submitting your application, please consider your application unsuccessful on this occasion.
We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.
r: Provide day-to-day legal advice and support to the company's Saudi Arabia business, with additional responsibility for other GCC markets as required.
Advise business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders on commercial, corporate, contractual and regulatory matters.
Support corporate governance, legal entity management and other general corporate affairs.
Identify, assess and mitigate legal and compliance risks associated with business operations, strategic initiatives and commercial transactions.
Provide practical, business-oriented solutions while ensuring adherence to applicable legal and ethical standards.
Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including:
Product supply, procurement and service agreements
Healthcare professional and healthcare organisation engagement agreements
Training, educational, research and clinical study agreements
Grants, sponsorships and other healthcare-related arrangements
Support negotiations with hospitals, healthcare institutions, distributors, commercial partners and other third parties.
Collaborate with regional and global legal teams to develop, review and improve standard contract templates, policies and legal processes.
Partner with regional and global Ethics & Compliance teams to ensure adherence to the company's compliance framework and applicable Saudi and GCC regulations.

Advise on healthcare compliance matters, including interactions with healthcare professionals and organisations, anti-bribery and anti-corruption requirements, third-party relationships and conflicts of interest.
Support compliance risk assessments, internal investigations and remediation activities in coordination with the relevant regional and global teams.
Assist in implementing, monitoring and continuously improving local compliance programmes, policies and internal controls.
Provide legal and compliance guidance on business initiatives, commercial practices and third-party engagements.
Monitor relevant legislative and regulatory developments in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, assessing their potential impact on business operations.
Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs and other functions on legal matters relating to medical devices, medical products, healthcare regulations and commercial activities.
Support the implementation of global legal procedures, approval processes, documentation standards and reporting requirements.
Liaise with external legal counsel and regulatory advisers where specialist or jurisdiction-specific expertise is required.
Develop and deliver legal and compliance training to commercial teams and other business stakeholders.
Promote awareness of legal obligations, ethical business conduct and corporate compliance requirements.
Work collaboratively with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, HR and other functions across the organisation.
Participate in regional and global legal initiatives and special projects as required.

d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

We are building a suite of tokenized equity capital markets products from the ground up, and are looking for a Research Analyst to join a small, high-impact team. This is a 0-to-1 opportunity for a self-starter who wants to help shape products from inception through launch.

The analyst will support the full product lifecycle — conducting due diligence on issuers, companies, vendors, and partners; building commercial and economic models; and producing the research, memos, and analysis that underpin key commercial decisions. The role is highly cross-functional, working closely with internal stakeholders in a fast-moving environment where initiative and ownership are essential.
q: Minimum 4 years of relevant experience, ideally within equity capital markets (ECM), or investment banking at a bank, advisory firm, or comparable institution.
Solid understanding of the equity capital markets and the mechanics of public and private capital raises (e.g. IPOs, follow-on offerings).
Strong financial modeling and quantitative analysis skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce polished, institutional-quality memos and presentations for senior stakeholders.
A genuine self-starter — comfortable with ambiguity, taking initiative, and building processes where none exist.
Strong attention to detail, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to operate under deadline pressure.
Familiarity with digital assets, tokenization, or a clear appetite to build expertise in bringing equity capital markets on-chain.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice.

r: Conduct thorough due diligence on prospective issuers, companies, vendors, partners, and counterparties, presenting findings in clear, decision-ready formats.
Perform fundamental analysis and build commercial and financial models to evaluate product structures, pricing, allocation, deal economics, and profitability.
Conduct competitor and market research across the capital markets landscape, benchmarking products, platforms, and market participants to inform positioning and strategy.
Prepare internal committee memos, decision documents, and management presentations that translate complex analysis into concise, actionable recommendations.
Track developments across the equity capital markets — pipeline, follow-on and related equity offerings, and broader market conditions — surfacing risks and opportunities proactively.
Support the transaction and product lifecycle, taking ownership of workstreams from research through to execution.

d: About Deloitte: When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.

Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities.
Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:
During Your Tenure As a Senior In Audit & Assurance, You Will Demonstrate And Develop Your Capabilities In The Following Areas
Builds trust and credibility with stakeholders by seeking to understand their service levels expectations and what matters to them individually.
Delivers high quality services by demonstrating a practical awareness of the impact of regulation and risk management on business processes and controls.
Takes responsibility for understanding key statistics and industry matters about entity before engagement begins.

Adapts template referral instructions to clearly outline the scope of procedures to be performed, including the areas of audit focus. Understands the structure of the group audit and for whom the referral instructions are intended.

Liaises effectively with onshore and offshore Centres of Excellence in the delivery of relevant tasks, understanding the scope of work delegated to them and the importance of providing accurate and complete information to them.
Assists in tracking deliverables from component auditors and seeks to understand the relevance and importance of these.
Appropriately links risks, controls, procedures and findings from allocated sections across the EMS file on a timely basis.
Can articulate the audit quality milestones, the ways in which teams demonstrate completeness of milestones, and how the audit quality milestones contribute to audit quality.
Understands the rationale behind the timings of the audit plan and is prepared to offer challenge around whether work can be performed earlier in the audit cycle.
Prepares documentation by anticipating questions that reviewers may ask and distinguishes accounting judgements and conclusions from auditing judgements and conclusions.
Understands that it is important to develop relationships beyond the finance function in order to better understand the entity's business and apply professional skepticism.
Has a practical awareness of the risks around the engagement lifecycle and regulatory environment, and relevant practice protection policies.
q: Builds own understanding of our purpose and values; explores opportunities for impact.

Understands expectations and demonstrates personal accountability for keeping performance on track.
Actively focuses on developing effective communication and relationship-building skills.
Understands how their daily work contributes to the priorities of the team and the business.
Degree in Accounting or related field. Graduate degree is desired.
4+ years of experience in public auditing and accounting, preferably with Big Audit Firms.
Supervise staff, inspect client financial records, compile and analyze data, prepare detailed audit reports and resolve accounting research issues.
Demonstrate ability to plan and manage engagements and people along with ensuring deliverables meet work plan specifications and deadlines.
International accounting qualification is desired: CA, ACCA, or CPA. Preferably CA.
Fluent in English (Reading, Speaking and Writing). Preference will be given to Bilingual candidates (Arabic/English).
